title: Clash at the burning shrine
story: Akane brings her katana down on Ren, who catches it on his blade in a shower of sparks. Beside them, Mira's roundhouse kick snaps into Gorou's jaw and sends the giant flying backwards, greatsword and all.
setting: burning shinto shrine courtyard at night, torii gate, stone lanterns, flying embers, fire, smoke

characters.name: Ren
characters.description: black-haired swordsman in a navy coat
